note: Town of Bow Island campground in Centennial Park at 1121 Centre St, with back access to the golf course; playground, splash park, walking track, soccer field and two camp kitchens. Sani-dump behind Silver Spray Car Wash (233 7 Ave), open 24/7. Site 9 needs an extension cord to reach power; the tent sites have no water. Water is on from May 1 to the fourth Monday of September. --Claude
